pages.text: Drills mine a plane facing the player. $(l)Sneak$() to switch to 1×1 mode.$(br2)They consume internal energy; the tooltip value is charge, not durability. Mining is cancelled when the drill has insufficient energy.

pages.title: Iron Drill
pages.text: 3×3 area, 1,700 FE capacity and 10 FE consumed per block.

pages.title: Diamond Drill
pages.text: 3×3 area, 5,000 FE capacity and 8 FE consumed per block.

pages.title: Netherite Drill
pages.text: 5×5 area, 10,000 FE capacity and 6 FE consumed per block.

pages.title: Quantum Drill
pages.text: 7×7 area, 35,000 FE capacity and 4 FE consumed per block.
